title: Endpoint scope
description: What the tools of this endpoint may see, per scope key, e.g. {"collections": ["handbook", "0b5e..."]}. A tool that needs a scope declares its key; an endpoint that allows such a tool needs a non-empty list for that key. References are resolved by the scope resolver of their key when the endpoint is saved (for example a name or a UUID) and stored as full ids; an unknown reference answers 422. Nothing is linked: when a referenced item is deleted later, its id stays here and the tools skip it.
